chapter: Social Histories of Early Societies (Kinship, Caste and Class)
questionText:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (The Azamgarh Proclamation):
(A) Section I
(B) Section II
(C) Section III
(D) Section IV

List-II (Social Group):
(I) Regarding Artisans
(II) Regarding Public Servants
(III) Regarding Zemindars
(IV) Regarding Merchants

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
The Azamgarh Proclamation, issued on 25 August 1857 under the name of Firoz Shah, appealed to all sections of Indian society to join the revolt:
- Section I: Regarding Zemindars (promising low revenue demand and full proprietary control) -> (III).
- Section II: Regarding Merchants (promising to eliminate custom tolls and monopoly steamers) -> (IV).
- Section III: Regarding Public Servants (promising higher salaries and prestigious posts) -> (II).
- Section IV: Regarding Artisans (promising royal patronage to revive native handicrafts destroyed by British imports) -> (I).
Matching: (A)-(III), (B)-(IV), (C)-(II), (D)-(I).
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.

questionText:
Arrange the major textual traditions in a chronological order:
 

(A) Compilation of Puranas (in Sanskrit)
(B) Major Dharmasutras (in Sanskrit)
(C) Sushruta Samhita (in Sanskrit)
(D) Manusmriti (in Sanskrit)
 
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Chronology: (B) The major Dharmasutras were composed between c. 500 BCE and 200 BCE; (D) The Manusmriti was compiled between c. 200 BCE and 200 CE; (C) The classical medical treatises Charaka and Sushruta Samhitas took shape around c. 100 CE to 300 CE; (A) The major Puranas were compiled from c. 200 CE to 500 CE. Sequence: (B), (D), (C), (A).
Hence, option (C) is correct.
